messages:
rhea: FYI onboarding atlas30b-qat hit a deterministic "misalignment" after compaction on long prefills (~120k tokens). Output drifts at the same token offset each run.

carlos: reproducible with a stress prefill? steps?

rhea: minimal repro below, using our nightly int8-qat runtime. Repro ~85% locally.

rhea: ```bash
# run inside container: redwood/runtime:qat-int8-nightly
python tests/long_prefill_kv_test.py --model atlas30b-qat --prefill tests/data/anchor_stream_120k.txt --window 65536 --seed 7
```

priya: what does "misalignment" look like in the traces? byte shift, duplicate keys, or lookup failure?

rhea: essentially a block of KV slots get shifted by one byte in the packed buffer after compaction. Not a crash, but identical key IDs land in adjacent slots so attention pulls a slightly different context.

kevin: could be packing/struct padding difference between the qat path and fp16 path. Have we validated slot struct sizes across ABIs?

rhea: I added an on-compact hexdump around the window boundary and saw this pattern: expected slot header: `01 ff 12 34 00` actual: `00 01 ff 12 34`. Looks like a left-rotate by one byte for a contiguous region.

carlos: left-rotate byte pattern -> smells like a miscalculated memmove with overlapping src/dst but wrong direction. Which memcpy variant are we using in compactor?

rhea: the compactor calls runtime::memmove_packed_entries with fast-path SIMD for int8 layout. That fast-path is guarded by is_aligned && !overlap detected by a simple if. I suspect the overlap check is flawed for our shrink-by-n algorithm.

priya: quick experiment: try switching to safe fallback memmove (non-SIMD) for the compaction and re-run. If corruption disappears it's a memmove overlap bug.

rhea: did that. Fallback path => 1/50 failures (noise), SIMD fast-path => ~42/50 failures.

bench-bot: created ticket RF-AL-2026 with labels [kv-cache, compaction, qat, onboarding].

kevin: any relation to RoPE/rescale? The drift might be amplified by slight rotary phase differences as the context shifts.

rhea: RoPE seems fine. Anchors/hash sequence unchanged. I instrumented anchor hashes pre/post compact and they matched, but slot ordering changed.

carlos: can you push a minimized unit test that reproduces in CI? Prefer a test that crafts overlapping ranges so memmove fast-path is exercised.

rhea: pushed test branch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/8531 - includes a deterministic reproducer and hex dump.

priya: nice. Also try toggling the quantized packing alignment (we have CONFIG_PACK_ALIGN=8 vs 16). Packing alignment change suppressed failures in my quick run. Might be an assumption in the fast-path about 16-byte alignment.

rhea: good catch. When I force PACK_ALIGN=16 the SIMD path no longer corrupts. With PACK_ALIGN=8 the bug shows up.

kevin: then root cause is the SIMD memmove assuming 16-byte lanes. If input alignment is 8 it performs a left-shift during vector copy when overlapping. We should update the overlap detection to use proper pointer arithmetic, or fallback to bytewise memmove when overlap detected in any lane.

carlos: plan: 1) hotfix to disable SIMD memmove when packing alignment != lane size, 2) add unit test to catch overlapping memmove corruption, 3) run full matrix (qat/int8,int4,fp16) on CI.

rhea: I'll open PR with hotfix and tests. Also adding a golden longprefill job to nightly with atlas30b-qat.

bench-bot: CI for PR 8531 started (matrix: qat-int8,int4,fp16 x PACK_ALIGN 8/16 x compaction on/off).

rhea: quick local numbers: before fix 42/50 failures, after hotfix 0/50 failures across 3 machines.

priya: awesome. Once green, let's run the regression suite for other onboards (magnet & kepler families) to be safe.

kevin: tagging eng-runtime and eng-infra for a driver & toolchain note; this bug can be silent across different compilers and glibc memmove optimizations.

rhea: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/8531 - includes description, testcase, and buffer hex references. Will follow up when merged.

carlos: thanks all. Add a short blurb to onboarding checklist: "validate compaction memmove for packing align variants"

rhea: done. Added to docs/onnboarding.md (tiny typo there but fixed in branch).

bench-bot: nightly job queued: longprefill-golden (atlas30b-qat).

priya: great thread. Keep an eye on dedicated CI for any flakiness post-merge. :eyes:
